title: Exstill: The Most Efficient Single-Chip Processor for the Next Token
abstract: arXiv:2611.18859v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generating a token with a language model requires a fixed amount of arithmetic, whose energy sets a floor beneath any hardware. For Qwen3-1.7B at a 16K-token context, gate-level measurements at 5 nm place this floor at 0.89 mJ per token, yet an NVIDIA B300 spends 391-1,120x that. The excess is the price of generality, software layers, programmable hardware and moving weights and key-value (KV) caches from external memory, and it widens with each process generation. We present a co-design approach that brings token generation close to this floor and then lowers the floor itself, optimizing silicon and model together in a gate-level search loop. Fixing one model architecture in the datapath, with weights still loadable, and holding weights and every conversation's KV cache on-die, a pre-silicon 5 nm design brings an unchanged Qwen3-1.7B token to 3.4x its floor. translated_title: Exstill：面向下一词元生成的最高效单芯片处理器
translated_abstract: 使用语言模型生成一个词元所需的算术运算是固定的，其能量消耗为任何硬件设定了下限。对于Qwen3-1.7B在16K词元上下文的情况下，5纳米工艺的门级测量表明这一下限为每词元0.89毫焦，而NVIDIA B300却消耗了下限的391-1,120倍。这些多余的能耗是通用性的代价——软件层、可编程硬件，以及从外部存储器搬运权重和键值（KV）缓存——并且随着每一代工艺的进步，这一差距还在不断扩大。我们提出一种协同设计方法，使词元生成逼近这一下限，进而降低下限本身，通过门级搜索环路对硅片和模型进行联合优化。将单一模型架构固定在数据通路中（权重仍可加载），并将权重与每个会话的KV缓存保存在片上，一份流片前的5纳米设计使未经修改的Qwen3-1.7B的每词元能耗降至其下限的3.4倍。在保持质量不变的前提下将模型与电路协同设计，可将该下限进一步降低。
tldr: 该论文提出面向大模型推理的软硬件协同设计单芯片处理器Exstill，通过将模型架构固定于数据通路并将权重与KV缓存全部驻留片上，使Qwen3-1.7B的每词元生成能耗仅为理论下限的3.4倍（GPU则高出数百倍），并通过模型与电路的联合优化进一步降低能耗下限。
en_tdlr: Exstill is a co-designed single-chip processor that fixes the model architecture in its datapath and keeps weights and KV caches fully on-die, bringing Qwen3-1.7B token generation to 3.4x the theoretical energy floor—versus hundreds-fold excess on GPUs—and further lowers that floor through joint model-circuit optimization.
